title: CWA WRF 15 km Urgent Prospective Collector
mission: Deploy an always-on collector for the rolling three-day CWA WRF archive and preserve every future issue with exact first-seen timestamps.
steps: Poll on a cadence that captures every 6-hourly run with retries and overlap.
Use /runs over the trailing window and deduplicate by run.
Collect HKO/station points, local patch and high-value surface/pressure variables.
Record first successful observation time per run/variable group.
Alert on missed cycles and coverage drops.
acceptance: No retained run silently lost after deployment
failure: API outage: preserve retry/alert evidence and recover within retention window
